articles.title: Google gains 25M subscriptions in Q1, driven by YouTube and Google One
articles.summary: Google added 25M paid subscriptions in Q1, reaching 350M total, as YouTube and Google One grow.

articles.title: Is AI video just a prequel? Runway’s CEO thinks world models are next
articles.summary: AI-generated video has gone from novelty to creative tool almost overnight, and Runway has a front row seat to the shift. The New York-based company has raised close to $860 million at a $5.3 billion valuation, and its models are going toe-to-toe with the most well-funded labs in the world, including Google and OpenAI. articles.title: Parallel Web Systems hits $2B valuation five months after its last big raise
articles.summary: The AI agent-tool startup founded by former Twitter CEO Parag Agrawal has raised $100 million, led by Sequoia, months after raising a previous $100 million.

articles.title: Google Photos uses AI to make the iconic closet from ‘Clueless’ a reality
articles.summary: Google says the new feature will leverage AI technology to automatically create a copy of your wardrobe that's based on the pieces of clothing appearing in your Google Photos library.

articles.title: More Gemini features are coming to Google TV
articles.summary: Google TV just got more Gemini features, including the ability to transform photos and videos with tools Nano Banana and Veo.

articles.title: Firestorm Labs raises $82M to take drone factories into the field
articles.summary: A defense startup just raised $82 million to put drone factories inside shipping containers and bring manufacturing to the front lines.

articles.title: Meet Shapes, the app bringing humans and AI into the same group chats
articles.summary: Think Discord chats, but with AI characters in addition to humans.

articles.title: Colby Adcock’s Scout AI raises $100M to train its models for war: We visited its bootcamp
articles.summary: We visited Scout AI's training ground where it's working on AI agents that can help individual soldiers control fleets of autonomous vehicles.

articles.title: At his OpenAI trial, Musk relitigates an old friendship
articles.summary: It's a story Musk has told before -- in interviews and to author Walter Isaacson for his bestselling biography of Musk -- but Tuesday was the first time he said it under oath.

articles.title: Amazon is already offering new OpenAI products on AWS
articles.summary: A day after OpenAI got Microsoft to agree to end exclusive rights, AWS announced a slate of OpenAI model offerings, including a new agent service.

articles.title: Amazon launches an AI-powered audio Q&A experience on product pages
articles.summary: Amazon's new "Join the chat" feature lets you ask questions about products and receive AI-powered audio responses.

articles.title: Google expands Pentagon’s access to its AI after Anthropic’s refusal
articles.summary: After Anthropic refused to allow the DoD to use its AI for domestic mass surveillance and autonomous weapons, Google has signed a new contract with the department.

articles.title: Lovable launches its vibe-coding app on iOS and Android
articles.summary: The app allows developers to vibe code web apps and websites on the go.

articles.title: YouTube is testing an AI-powered search feature that shows guided answers
articles.summary: YouTube is rolling out the new AI search feature to Premium subscribers in the U.S. on an opt-in basis.

articles.title: BCI startup Neurable looks to license its ‘mind-reading’ tech for consumer wearables
articles.summary: The startup specializes in "non-invasive" "mind-reading" tech — a kind of neural data collection that, its CEO hopes, will have all sorts of consumer applications.

articles.title: Red Hat’s OpenClaw maintainer just made enterprise Claw deployments a lot safer
articles.summary: Tank OS puts OpenClaw AI agents into a container that lets it run reliably and more safely, especially for those running fleets of them.

articles.title: Otter’s new feature lets users search across their enterprise tools
articles.summary: With this launch, users can connect their Gmail, Google Drive, Notion, Jira, and Salesforce accounts and query that data along with existing meeting data. The company said that it will soon allow connections with Microsoft Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, and Slack.

articles.title: OpenAI ends Microsoft legal peril over its $50B Amazon deal
articles.summary: OpenAI has won major concessions from its largest shareholder, Microsoft, that will allow it to sell products on AWS, while Microsoft gets more cash in a revenue-share agreement.

articles.title: DeepMind’s David Silver just raised $1.1B to build an AI that learns without human data
articles.summary: Ineffable Intelligence, a British AI lab founded a mere few months ago by former DeepMind researcher David Silver, has raised $1.1 billion in funding at a valuation of $5.1 billion.

articles.title: Investors back Skye’s AI home screen app for iPhone ahead of launch
articles.summary: Skye's new AI app attracted investors before it even launched — a sign of interest in a more AI-aware iPhone.

articles.title: Police charge two men over 5G telecom tower arson attacks in Northern Ireland
articles.summary: The two men will appear in court next month

articles.summary: Will now go to a third meeting

articles.title: DCD>Studio: Developing hyperscale facilities in Europe, with Fabien Vieu, Sepia Infrastructure
articles.summary: Seb Moss speaks with Fabien Vieu of Sepia Infrastructure on developing European hyperscale campuses, land strategy, long-term asset management, and building community trust through responsible data center development.

articles.summary: Company aims high with planned pipeline

articles.summary: Works expected to cost $23m

articles.summary: Vesa Tykkyläinen to step down after nearly seven years

articles.title: Hut 8 selling $3.25bn in bonds to finance Google and Anthropic-backed River Bend AI data center campus
articles.summary: Development will act as the first leg in a 2.295GW partnership with Fluidstack and Anthropic

articles.title: Bill proposed in North Carolina seeks to mandate large load data centers to cover cost of energy and water infrastructure
articles.summary: Proposed by Democrat Lindsey Prather

articles.title: Apple scales out 6G ambitions with engineer job listings
articles.summary: Tech giant's moves follow recent MWC partnership with Ericsson

articles.title: NTT to support Rapidus liquid-cooled GPU server deployment in Japan
articles.summary: Liquid-cooled deployment needed for chip design and manufacture

articles.title: AI cloud Verda to deploy Arm's AGI CPU in its data centers
articles.summary: Becomes latest partner to use new AI chip co-designed with Meta

articles.title: Rethinking data center energy delivery
articles.summary: How behind-the-meter biomethane generation can turn grid uncertainty into a controllable delivery variable

articles.title: UK government to launch AI Hardware Plan later this year
articles.summary: Technology Secretary Liz Kendall said she will not accept “defeatism” that the hardware race has already been won by the US and Taiwan

articles.title: Compass pulls out of PW Digital Gateway project, residents sue to get out of contracts with QTS
articles.summary: The original gigawatt campus project suffers more setbacks

articles.title: APAC data center developer Digital Edge said to be weighing options for investment - report
articles.summary: Stonepeak-owned operator could be looking for new investment

articles.title: Zoning board of Sharon, PA, approves planned expansion of Keel Infrastructure’s existing data center development
articles.summary: Project overseen by company formerly known as Bitfarms now heads to Mercer County Regional Planning Commission for approval

articles.title: Polish city of Gliwice to build its own data center
articles.summary: Project in southern Poland will provide greater digital resiliency for municipality

articles.title: Vodafone pairs with National Physical Laboratory to trial fiber-based alternative to GNSS timing
articles.summary: Although the trials are UK-based for now, Vodafone plans to roll out to Europe

articles.title: Cerberus closes $2.3bn single asset continuation vehicle on subsea operator SubCom
articles.summary: Will support SubCom's continued expansion plans

articles.title: Octopus Energy, Lunar Energy roll out battery-enabled electricity plans in Texas
articles.summary: It’s the latest Texas program to offer customers a deeply discounted battery that provides grid support as well as home backup power.

articles.title: At 106 GW, gas-fired generation leads PJM’s newly reopened interconnection queue
articles.summary: After being effectively closed since 2022, the PJM Interconnection has launched the first cycle of its revamped interconnection queue process with more than 800 projects totaling 220 GW seeking to connect to the grid.

articles.title: CAISO expects ‘solid launch’ for EDAM, first Western day-ahead market
articles.summary: Mike Wilding of PacifiCorp, EDAM’s inaugural participant, told Utility Dive that 90 days of parallel operations in preparation for launch have given him confidence that “the market is working as intended and as designed.”

articles.title: MISO capacity prices fall as new supply outpaces demand growth
articles.summary: Capacity offered in the Midcontinent Independent System Operator’s summer auction jumped 3.4% to 141 GW from 136.3 GW a year ago, partly driven by solar additions.

articles.title: Capacity cost explosion: What PJM’s $80B bill means for the AI buildout
articles.summary: To avoid an era of grid instability, electric-sector stakeholders must fast-track replacement generation, deploy grid-enhancing technologies and pass permitting reform, writes EnerKnol’s Shahid Mahdi.

articles.title: TVA, Plus Power to deploy 200 MW/800 MWh BESS in Alabama
articles.summary: Crawfish Creek would be one of the first grid-scale battery projects in TVA territory and a significant down payment toward its board-approved plan to deploy up to 1.5 GW of energy storage by 2029.

articles.title: Industrial loads boost Consumers Energy’s sales as coal plant emergency order costs rise
articles.summary: At least one analyst on Tuesday’s earnings call raised concerns about Consumers’ regulatory strategy after DTE Energy said it may pause future rate hike requests if its current request is approved.

articles.title: Americans deserve facts, not fearmongering, about their electric bills
articles.summary: Policymakers must remove barriers to new infrastructure and allow competitive power markets to function properly, writes Todd Snitchler, CEO of the Electric Power Supply Association.

articles.title: 2 more offshore wind projects scrapped under Trump administration pressure
articles.summary: The government said Bluepoint Wind and Golden State Wind have “agreed to voluntarily end their offshore wind leases.” EDP, a Portuguese company with stakes in both projects, said it has “agreed to settle imminent claims.”

articles.title: Major critical infrastructure supplier reports cyberattack
articles.summary: Itron, which claims to have contracts with more than 7,700 utility providers in 100 countries, said it “has not observed any subsequent unauthorized activity within its corporate systems” nor unauthorized access to customer data.

articles.title: Application lodged to build microreactor at US university
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission announced it has received an application from the University of Illinois to construct the first research KRONOS micro modular reactor on the university's campus.

articles.title: Bulgarian minister wants fixed price for Kozloduy 7 and 8
articles.summary: Minister of Energy Traycho Traykov has said Bulgaria wants its proposed new nuclear power units at the Kozloduy plant to be built at fixed prices.

articles.title: Dutch agreement paves way for construction of commercial MSR
articles.summary: A memorandum of understanding has been signed for the construction of a non-nuclear demonstrator Thorizon molten-salt reactor in the Dutch province of Zeeland, a nuclear demonstrator at Petten, Noord-Holland, followed by the first commercial unit in Zeeland.

articles.title: First Taipingling unit enters commercial operation
articles.summary: Unit 1 of the Taipingling nuclear power plant has entered commercial operation, China General Nuclear announced. The unit is the first of six Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors planned for the site in Guangdong province.

articles.title: OSGE and development agency sign agreement for Polish SMR project
articles.summary: Poland's Orlen Synthos Green Energy has signed a letter of intent with the country's Industrial Development Agency to collaborate on the preparation for the construction and operation of small modular reactors at the Strategic Investment Park in Stalowa Wola.

articles.title: Kairos breaks ground for Hermes 2 reactor
articles.summary: The Hermes 2 Demonstration Plant in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, will be the company's first commercial-scale reactor and is the first power-producing Gen IV reactor to receive a construction permit from the US regulator.

articles.title: First new Kursk unit 'ready for commercial operation'
articles.summary: The first VVER-TOI unit at the Kursk II Nuclear Power Plant in Russia has successfully completed pilot operation and is ready for commercial operation, Rosatom says.

articles.title: Grants allocated for Swedish feasibility studies
articles.summary: The Swedish Environmental Protection Agency has distributed SEK19.8 million (USD2.2 million) to nine municipalities that have applied to carry out feasibility studies for new nuclear power.

articles.title: Reactor vessel installed at third Zhangzhou unit
articles.summary: The reactor pressure vessel has been installed at unit 3 of the Zhangzhou nuclear power plant in China's Fujian province, China National Nuclear Corporation announced. Zhangzhou 3 is the third of six HPR1000 (Hualong One) units planned for the site.

articles.title: Korean financing to be considered for Vietnam projects
articles.summary: The Export-Import Bank of Korea, Korea Trade Insurance Corporation, Korea Electric Power Corporation and Petrovietnam have agreed to explore possible South Korean financing of nuclear power projects in Vietnam.

articles.title: TerraPower starts construction of 'first US utility-scale advanced nuclear plant'
articles.summary: TerraPower has announced the official start of construction on its first Natrium plant, Kemmerer unit 1 in Wyoming. The Bill Gates-chaired company says the unit will be the first utility-scale advanced nuclear power plant in the United States.

articles.title: US Air Force announces selections for microreactor deployments
articles.summary: The US Department of the Air Force has selected Radiant Industries, Inc, Westinghouse Government Services and Antares Inc as potential microreactor developers and operators under its Advanced Nuclear Power for Installations initiative, as well as announcing a third potential location for a reactor.

articles.title: Operating licence issued for Bangladesh's first nuclear power unit
articles.summary: The inspection of primary equipment at Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant unit 1 has been completed, showing the unit in Bangladesh is now ready for first criticality, and an operating licence issued.

articles.title: Inner dome installed at Shidaowan unit 1
articles.summary: The inner safety dome has been installed on the containment building of unit 1 of the Shidaowan nuclear power plant site, China Huaneng announced. Shidaowan 1 is the first of four HPR1000 (Hualong One) units planned for the site in China's Shandong Province.

articles.title: Stellaria, CEA to consider experimental MSR at Cadarache
articles.summary: French molten salt reactor developer Stellaria has signed a letter of intent with the Alternative Energies & Atomic Energy Commission for a feasibility study for constructing its Alvin experimental reactor at its Cadarache site in southern France.

articles.title: Czech SMR project - early works contract signed
articles.summary: Czech nuclear operator ČEZ has signed an early works contract with Rolls-Royce SMR for the proposed construction of a small modular reactor at Temelín. ČEZ has also signed a memorandum of understanding with the Ministry of Industry and Trade to consider the investor model and possible sources of financing.

articles.title: Hot tests completed at second San'ao unit
articles.summary: Tests that simulate the temperatures and pressures which the reactor systems will be subjected to during normal operation have been completed at unit 2 of the San'ao nuclear power plant in China's Zhejiang province. The unit is the second of six HPR1000s (Hualong Ones) planned at the site.

articles.title: Fuel loading begins for Bangladesh’s first nuclear power plant
articles.summary: A ceremony has been held in Bangladesh to mark the start of the loading of 163 nuclear fuel assemblies into Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant’s first unit.

articles.title: Flushing of safety systems begins for Kudankulam unit 3
articles.summary: The flushing of safety systems at unit 3 of India’s Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant is described as a key moment, signifying the beginning of the active commissioning phase.

articles.title: Rostekhnadzor approves Kursk II's first unit's readiness
articles.summary: Russian nuclear regulator Rostekhnadzor has issued a certificate of compliance for the first VVER-TOI reactor unit at the new phase of the Kursk nuclear power plant.
